item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":1,"rationale":"The President directs the Secretary of State to pursue cooperative arrangements with foreign governments, but leaves their terms and successful conclusion to later diplomacy; the segment does not itself alter legal status or dictate a specific agency-imposed legal consequence.","evidence":"shall undertake to enter into, on behalf of the United States, cooperative arrangements with appropriate foreign governments"},{"segment_id":"2","code":2,"rationale":"The Secretary must issue instructions requiring the Coast Guard later to stop and board covered vessels, investigate those aboard, and return vessels and passengers when the stated conditions are met. Those later operational acts impose the specified legal consequence.","evidence":"Those instructions to the Coast Guard shall include appropriate directives providing for the Coast Guard"},{"segment_id":"3","code":1,"rationale":"The Attorney General is directed to coordinate and take whatever implementation and enforcement steps are necessary, leaving the particular measures and outcomes to executive discretion.","evidence":"take whatever steps are necessary to ensure the fair enforcement of our laws relating to immigration"}]}
